You MUST use the search_web tool to find today's news. Do exactly 4 searches, one for each section below. After all searches complete, compile the results and save them to a file, then send to Discord.

Step 1: Run these 4 searches using search_web:
- Search 1: "latest cybersecurity news today"
- Search 2: "stock market news today S&P 500 NASDAQ Dow Jones"
- Search 3: "world news today major headlines"
- Search 4: "Nepal news today latest"

Step 2: After all searches, write the results to a file at c:\Antigravity agents\daily_briefing.md using this EXACT format:

# 📰 Daily News Briefing — [Today's Date]

## 🔒 Cybersecurity
- **[Headline 1]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- **[Headline 2]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- (list 5-8 stories as bullet points, each with a hyperlink to the source article)

## 📈 Stock Market

### Market Snapshot
| Index | Close | Change |
|---|---|---|
| S&P 500 | [value] | [change] |
| Dow Jones | [value] | [change] |
| NASDAQ | [value] | [change] |

- **[Headline 1]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- **[Headline 2]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- (list 5-8 stories as bullet points, each with a hyperlink to the source article)

## 🌍 World News
- **[Headline 1]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- **[Headline 2]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- (list 5-8 stories as bullet points, each with a hyperlink to the source article)

## 🇳🇵 Nepal News
- **[Headline 1]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- **[Headline 2]** — one-line summary | [Source Name](https://source-url)
- (list 5-8 stories as bullet points, each with a hyperlink to the source article)

## 🔑 Key Takeaway
Write one paragraph summarizing the single most critical story across all four categories and why it matters.

RULES:
- Each story is ONE bullet point with a bold headline, a single-line summary, and a markdown hyperlink to the source article. No paragraphs in the news sections.
- EVERY bullet point MUST end with a clickable source link in markdown format: [Source Name](https://url)
- The Market Snapshot table MUST be filled with actual index values from the search results.
- The Key Takeaway MUST be included at the end.
- Do NOT skip any section.
- Do NOT give explanations or preamble. Search, write the file, then run the Discord command.
- You MUST complete all 3 steps: search, save file, send to Discord.

Step 3: After saving the file, run this command to send it to Discord:
python "c:\Antigravity agents\discord_send.py" "c:\Antigravity agents\daily_briefing.md"
description: Every day at 9:00 AM (America/New_York), searches the web for news, saves a briefing with source hyperlinks, and sends it to Discord via webhook.
